documents.title: Endocrinology surveillance
documents.author: endocrinology
documents.body: Three-year surveillance after resection of a left adrenal pheochromocytoma. No paroxysmal symptoms. Plasma free metanephrine 38 and normetanephrine 95 pg/mL, within normal limits. Germline panel was negative. Continue annual plasma metanephrines.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual, fasting. 37 now.

Quiet year since the October ED visit. No urinary symptoms, no headaches to speak of, no spells, no eye/neck episodes. Endocrinology surveillance in January normal. Psychiatry every 2-3 months, risperidone 3 mg BID, stable. Same warehouse job, day shift.

Meds: risperidone 3 BID, metformin 1000 BID, amlodipine 10, HCTZ 25, atenolol 50.
Allergies: phenazopyridine (methemoglobinemia).
PSH: laparoscopic L adrenalectomy 2022.
SH: never smoker; social alcohol; no drugs.
FH: father DM2, mother HTN, maternal uncle schizophrenia.

ROS negative. PHQ-9 = 2.

Exam
BP 136/84, wt 101.8 kg (BMI ~34).
Well-appearing. HEENT normal; neck supple, thyroid normal size.
Chest wall: soft symmetric breast tissue, unchanged.
Heart regular without murmur. Lungs clear.
Abdomen obese, soft, nontender; healed port scars.
Ext no edema. Feet: skin intact, web spaces clear, monofilament normal, pulses 2+.
Skin no rash. Neuro nonfocal.

Plan
- DM2: A1c, CMP, urine ACR today. Eye exam July.
- HTN: three drugs, continue.
- CKD 1: ACR, creatinine.
- Lipids today.
- Obesity/pseudogynecomastia: stable.
- Migraine: none since last spring.
- Prevention: flu and covid this fall. Tdap good until 2031. Screens done (HIV, HCV).
RTC 3 months.

documents.title: Physical labs
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Labs from Wednesday: A1c 7.9. Kidney function normal, urine albumin 98 (your usual range). Blood counts and liver tests normal. Cholesterol attached. Same medicines; see you in June.

documents.author: psychiatry
documents.body: Medication management update. Continues risperidone 3 mg twice daily with good symptom control and no adverse movement effects. Engaged in care, working, no admissions. No changes. Thank you for continuing his metabolic labs.
